pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with softened, low-contrast edge gradients. Geometry is characterized by rounded vertices and moderate spatial area variance, with patch size decreasing slightly towards the anterior neck and posterior limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous reticulum of light-colored pelage pathways. Junction nodes at intersections demonstrate slight pixel-width expansion relative to the connecting segments. The network is uninterrupted across the visible lateral flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, fine-textured serrated silhouette is visible along the dorsal neck ridge, representing the mane. The profile shows high-frequency, minute vertical projections against the background.
